column1: # APSE prophage integration sites in Hamiltonella defensa S05 (strain H76).
# Coordinates are 1-based inclusive and refer to the delivered 2024 curated
# contigs, so they can be applied to the published assembly. S05's chromosome is
# in fragments, hence the contig column.
# The ~805 kb site is POLYMORPHIC: the RHS phage and the recombinant hapA share
# integrase type A and therefore the same att core, so a given cell carries one
# or the other.
# Occupancy can only be counted on the attL side (chromosome 805,721). On the
# attR side hapA is RHS-derived and the two are identical, so reads there cannot
# be assigned. At attL the filtered read set gives RHS 5 : hapA 7; an earlier
# count on the full raw read set, before hapA was fully characterised, gave
# 15 : 5 the other way. Both are small and they disagree, so OCCUPANCY AT THIS
# SITE IS NOT DETERMINED beyond "both lineages are common". Resolving it needs
# deeper chromosome coverage, which is 10-14x here.
# assemblies_v2/S05_v2.fasta carries the RHS phage at this site because it is
# the complete circular lineage and the one already in the 2024 delivery; hapA
# is supplied as a separate reference, not because it is rarer.
sample
